C1060.title: Three Arrested for Illegally Setting Up GOIP Devices
C1060.summary: On July 25, 2025, police in Ningyuan, Hunan investigated a case involving GOIP devices used to facilitate telecom fraud. Officers arrested Chen Moujun and seized four SIM cards from his vehicle, then arrested Zhou Mouwen and Yuan Mouxiang while they were operating GOIP equipment in a county hotel. The three knowingly provided call relaying and messaging support despite the devices' likely use in fraud. They were detained, and the case remained under investigation.
